children: Cathay General Bancorp's net interest income and earnings rose year over year, supported by higher interest income from loans and investment securities and lower deposit and FHLB borrowing costs. Higher equity-security gains and a TruPS redemption benefit lifted noninterest income, partly offset by a realized securities repositioning loss and higher operating expenses.
² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Increased 11.8% to $211.9M, primarily on higher loan and investment-security income and lower deposit and FHLB advance costs.
: Rose to 3.52% from 3.31% in the year-earlier quarter.
: Rose 103.8%, driven mainly by a $32.8M increase in equity-security gains and a $3.1M TruPS redemption benefit; a $15.1M securities-sale loss partly offset gains.
: Gross loans held for investment reached $21.20B at September 30, 2026, up 5.2% from December 31, 2025, led by commercial loan growth.
: Nonperforming assets fell 17.0% to $119.2M from December 31, 2025; the allowance for loan losses was 1.06% of gross loans.
